pages.title: Overview
pages.text:
Hybrid melee/thrown weapon. Attack speed 1.6. Melee attacks are guaranteed critical hits (jump-crit sound & particles).

• Melee damage: 10. Can strip logs.
• Guaranteed melee crit: final damage ×1.5 (single multiplier, no stacking).
• Thrown: hold right-click to charge, release to throw. Base damage 10 on hit. Retrievable.
• Any holder (player or doll) executes melee targets below 30% HP.
• 80% dodge while held (main or offhand) — player only.

Repair: ender pearls. Both melee and thrown attacks execute at 30% HP for players and dolls alike; the Ender doll's talent execute also uses the 30% threshold while wielding this axe. Dodge stays player-only — dolls keep their own variant dodge, never stacking.
